title: Honky Tonk Hideaway | Minutes to Broadway
description:
Relax in this beautifully decorated condo just a short walk from Broadway! Sleeping up to 8 guests, it features a spacious kitchen, comfortable living area, private balcony with downtown Nashville views, and plenty of room to unwind before or after a night out. Enjoy access to the fitness center, 5th-floor gathering space, and main-floor lounge. The perfect home base for your Music City getaway!

Nashville Permit #2022073911

The space
Enjoy gathering in the spacious open-concept living area, featuring a fully equipped kitchen, dining space, and comfortable living room—the perfect place to relax and share stories before or after exploring Broadway.

The kitchen includes a full-size refrigerator, oven, microwave, blender, and all the cookware, dishes, and essentials you'll need to prepare meals or reheat your favorite Nashville takeout.

The condo comfortably sleeps up to 8 guests. The primary bedroom features a king bed and a private ensuite bathroom. The second bedroom offers two queen beds and its own ensuite bathroom. A self-inflating queen air mattress is also provided for additional sleeping space.

As a corner unit, the private balcony offers beautiful views of the Nashville skyline—an ideal spot to enjoy your morning coffee or unwind after a night out.

**Muse Building Amenities**

* Rooftop lounge with outdoor seating and skyline views
* Modern fitness center
* Two elevators
* Spacious lobby for gathering before heading out
* The Drip Bar next door is an official Bounce luggage storage location, making early arrivals and late departures even more convenient.

Guest access
Guests have full access to the entire corner-unit condo and all building amenities. Enjoy a spacious, fully equipped kitchen with everything needed to prepare meals, a comfortable living area, and two ensuite bathrooms with double vanities, making it easy for everyone to get ready.

In-Unit Amenities

Private balcony with city views
Fully equipped kitchen
In-unit washer & dryer (laundry detergent provided)
Shampoo, conditioner, body wash, and makeup remover in each bathroom
Smart TVs in the living room and both bedrooms

Building Amenities

Fitness center (1st floor)
Sky Lounge with indoor seating and a large outdoor patio (5th floor)
Spacious lobby, perfect for gathering before heading out to explore Nashville
